name: Biblo
long_description:
Biblo is a personal AI agent that helps you get healthier, starting right in your texts.

Send Biblo a photo of your food to track calories and macros, log workouts, or get personalized coaching based on your goals.

But Biblo goes beyond tracking. It learns your habits, preferences, and routines to help you make decisions and take action. We're building it to handle things like ordering food that fits your goals, planning workouts around your schedule, and taking care of everyday tasks on your behalf.

Our vision is a personal AI that knows you well enough to anticipate what you need and get things done, not just answer questions.
one_liner: Your personal AI fitness coach, over iMessage.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Software still makes people do most of the work.

If you want to get healthier, you have to track every meal, manage your workouts, remember your goals, and navigate multiple apps that barely know anything about you. Even AI assistants mostly wait for instructions. You still have to know what to ask and follow through yourself.

We're building Biblo to change that.

Biblo is a personal AI agent that gets to know you and helps you take action. Today, it's a fitness coach you can text. Send a photo of your food to track calories and macros, log workouts, and get personalized guidance. We're building toward an agent that can do things on your behalf, like ordering food that fits your goals or adjusting your workouts around your schedule.

Our team previously built AI tools that create and use software. We kept coming back to the same realization: AI is becoming incredibly capable, but software still knows surprisingly little about the person using it.

We think the next breakthrough isn't just smarter software. It's software that actually understands you.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
We believe everyone will have a personal AI that knows them as well as a great human assistant would.

Today, software is organized around apps. You have to figure out which service to use, navigate its interface, and tell it what you want. Even the most advanced AI assistants still leave much of the actual work to you.

We think that changes.

Imagine an AI that understands your goals, preferences, habits, and schedule. It doesn't just tell you what to eat. It can order the meal. It doesn't just create a workout plan. It adapts the plan as your life changes.

Over time, that same AI could help manage your travel, shopping, scheduling, and other everyday responsibilities. Sometimes the best interface will be a text. Other times it might be a personalized app. The experience should adapt to what you're trying to accomplish.

Our vision is a world where software no longer requires people to navigate dozens of disconnected apps. Instead, everyone has a personal agent that understands what they need and can help get it done.

The future of software isn't more apps. It's software that knows you.
